items.title: 70+ Fake Windows App Sites Pushing Malware Right Now
items.summary: Searching Google for a Windows app? The first result might be a trap. Security researchers found over 70 fake websites impersonating popular Windows programs — VLC (videolan.org), Notepad++ (notepad-plus-plus.org), 7-Zip (7-zip.org), WinRAR (win-rar.com). They buy Google ads so they appear above the real site. Click "Download" and you get malware that steals passwords, mines crypto, or locks your files. Bookmark the real sites or get apps from the Microsoft Store. If a download page asks you to run an .exe from a suspicious domain, close the tab immediately.

items.title: Firefox adds HDR video, QR code sharing, and PDF merging — free at firefox.com
items.summary: Firefox (released July 21, 2026) adds HDR video playback on Windows, QR code sharing from any page (right-click → Share → Generate QR Code), and drag-and-drop PDF merging in the built-in PDF editor. Download free at firefox.com or update via Menu → Help → About Firefox.

items.title: Run your own private AI chatbot offline free — Jan.ai installs in minutes at jan.ai
items.summary: Jan.ai is a free, open-source app that runs AI models entirely on your PC — no internet, no account, no data leaves your machine. Download at jan.ai or github.com/janhq/jan/releases. Needs 8 GB+ RAM; works on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

items.title: Major Password Breaches: 85 Million Records Exposed — Check Yours Now
items.summary: Two massive breaches hit this month: Abbott Labs lost 30M+ cancer records (SSNs, medical histories, insurance). Suno AI leaked 55M users' names, emails, and partial payment data. If you reused a password anywhere, criminals are testing it on banks, email, and shopping sites. Go to HaveIBeenPwned.com — if your email shows, change that password everywhere. Use unique passwords per account (Bitwarden/1Password/KeePass) and enable 2FA on email and banking today.

items.title: Nvidia Extends Windows 10 RTX Driver Support Through October 2026
items.summary: Security updates only for older GPUs (GTX 900/1000 series), buying time if your PC can't run Windows 11.

items.title: Florida Awards $223M to Expand Rural Broadband
items.summary: Fiber builds targeting underserved Panhandle and North Florida communities including areas around Lake City. Check the Florida Office of Broadband map for your address.

items.title: Windows 11 July Update Patches 570 Flaws Including 3 Zero-Days
items.summary: Microsoft's AI tools found bugs 4× faster than last year. Update installs automatically; just restart when prompted.

items.title: Fix a Spotty Wi-Fi Connection in 3 Minutes
items.summary: Unplug your router's power cord, wait 30 full seconds, plug it back in. Wait two minutes for all lights to settle. This clears stuck connections and memory leaks that slow things down. If it's still slow, move the router off the floor, away from thick walls and the microwave — signals travel better with breathing room.

items.title: FTC Warns: Fake CAPTCHA Scams Hijack Your Computer
items.summary: Scammers use fake CAPTCHAs that tell you to press Windows+R, paste, and Enter — this runs malicious code. Real CAPTCHAs never ask for keyboard commands. Close the tab immediately if a verification asks you to open Run or paste anything.

items.title: Microsoft Fixes 622 Security Flaws — Biggest Patch Tuesday Ever
items.summary: July 2026 Patch Tuesday addresses 622 vulnerabilities including 6 critical remote code execution flaws and starts mandatory Kerberos RC4 enforcement. Open Settings → Windows Update → Check for updates, install, and restart. Network admins: test Kerberos AES compatibility.

items.title: Storage Sense — Windows' Free Cleanup Tool Runs Automatically
items.summary: Press Start and type "Storage Sense", turn it On. Click Configure Storage Sense and choose how often to run (daily/weekly/monthly). Set Delete files in Recycle Bin after to 30 days. Set Delete files in Downloads folder after to 60 days (or Never if you keep installers). Automatically frees 10-50 GB of temp files and junk — no extra software needed. Works on Windows 10 and 11.
